{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = '/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv'
df = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Identify QA orders (revenue = '999999.99')
qa_orders = df[df['revenue'] == '999999.99']

# Remove QA orders from the dataset
df_clean = df[~df.index.isin(qa_orders.index)]

# Filter to only completed orders
completed_only = df_clean[df_clean['status'] == 'completed']

# Compute conversion rate by segment
conversion_by_segment = completed_only.groupby('customer_segment')['converted'].mean()

# Find the segment with the highest conversion rate
best_segment = conversion_by_segment.idxmax()

# Output the result
print(f"Highest conversion rate segment: {best_segment}")
print("Conversion rates after removing QA orders:\n", conversion_by_segment)"}
